entries.q.tobacco.current: Do you currently use any tobacco, smoked or smokeless (for example cigarettes, shisha or chewing tobacco)?
entries.q.auditc.1: How often do you have a drink containing alcohol?
entries.q.auditc.2: How many standard drinks containing alcohol do you have on a typical day when you drink?
entries.q.auditc.3: How often do you have six or more drinks on one occasion?
entries.q.activity.moderate: In a typical week, how many minutes do you spend on moderate activity that makes you breathe a little faster, such as brisk walking, carrying loads or cycling?
entries.q.activity.vigorous: In a typical week, how many minutes do you spend on vigorous activity that makes you breathe much faster, such as running, football or heavy digging?
entries.q.diet.servings: On a typical day, how many servings of fruit and vegetables do you eat? One serving is about a handful.
entries.q.diet.salt: Do you add salt to your food at the table?
entries.q.wellness.title: Mood and stress (optional)
entries.q.wellness.intro: These questions ask how you have been feeling over the last two weeks: your mood, sleep, energy, worry and stress. They are optional. You can skip any question, or this whole part, and nothing else changes.
entries.q.wellness.risk: If an answer suggests you may not be safe, Rinda will show you people you can talk to straight away. Rinda never contacts anyone for you.
entries.q.wellness.separate: Mood and stress results are shown on their own and are never added to your other results.
entries.q.phq9.stem: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?
entries.q.phq9.1: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
entries.q.phq9.3: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
entries.q.phq9.4: Feeling tired or having little energy
entries.q.phq9.6: Feeling bad about yourself, or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
entries.q.phq9.7: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading or watching television
entries.q.phq9.8: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed, or the opposite: being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
entries.q.phq9.9: Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way
entries.q.gad7.stem: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?
entries.q.gad7.1: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
entries.q.gad7.2: Not being able to stop or control worrying
entries.q.gad7.3: Worrying too much about different things
entries.q.gad7.5: Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
entries.q.gad7.7: Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen
